products.name: VAHA AI
products.description: An AI-powered personal tutor that adapts to every learner. VAHA AI builds custom learning paths, answers doubts instantly in natural language, and tracks progress with intelligent analytics.
products.long_description: VAHA AI is our flagship AI education platform built for schools, colleges, and self-learners. It combines large language models with adaptive learning science to act as a personal tutor for every student. Learners can ask questions by text or voice, get step-by-step explanations, take auto-generated quizzes, and follow study plans that adjust in real time to their strengths and weaknesses. Teachers get dashboards showing exactly where each student struggles, and institutions can plug in their own syllabus and question banks.
features: AI doubt-solving chat with step-by-step explanations
Adaptive learning paths personalised per student
Voice-based tutoring in English and Tamil
Custom syllabus and question bank integration

benefits.title: A Personal Tutor for Every Student
benefits.text: No two students learn alike. VAHA AI adapts explanations, pace, and practice to each learner, so weak areas get extra attention automatically.

benefits.title: Doubts Cleared in Seconds, 24/7
benefits.text: Students never wait for the next class to ask a question. Instant step-by-step answers keep momentum and confidence high.

benefits.title: Teachers See Everything
benefits.text: Dashboards show exactly which concept each student is stuck on, so teaching time goes where it matters most.

benefits.title: Fraction of the Cost of Tuition
benefits.text: Institutions offer premium personalised tutoring at a price every parent can afford - and a new revenue stream for the school.

how_it_works.title: Plug in Your Syllabus
how_it_works.text: Upload your curriculum, textbooks, and question banks - or start with our ready CBSE, State Board, and competitive exam packs.

how_it_works.title: Students Start Learning
how_it_works.text: Learners chat with the AI tutor by text or voice, take adaptive quizzes, and follow study plans tuned to their level.

how_it_works.title: The AI Adapts Daily
how_it_works.text: Every answer updates the student model. Difficulty, revision, and practice adjust automatically each day.

how_it_works.title: Track and Improve
how_it_works.text: Teachers and parents get weekly progress reports, mastery maps, and early warnings before exams.

testimonial.quote: Our average class scores went up 18% in one term. Students actually enjoy asking VAHA AI the questions they were too shy to ask in class.
testimonial.author: Priya Raghavan

faq.q: Does VAHA AI work with our own syllabus and question papers?
faq.a: Yes. You can upload your curriculum, notes, and question banks, and the tutor answers strictly within your syllabus. Ready-made packs for CBSE, Tamil Nadu State Board, NEET, and JEE are also included.

faq.q: What languages does the tutor support?
faq.a: English and Tamil today, with voice input and output in both. Hindi is on the roadmap.
